description: This file defines the StorageFaultGrain class, a grain used in Orleans testing to simulate storage faults by tracking exceptions for read, write, and clear operations and injecting them when triggered.

classes.name: StorageFaultGrain
classes.description: Grain implementing IStorageFaultGrain interface to simulate storage faults for testing purposes.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Initializes the grain, setting up logging and fault dictionaries.

methods.name: AddFaultOnRead
methods.description: Registers a fault to be thrown on the next read operation for a specific GrainId.

methods.name: AddFaultOnWrite
methods.description: Registers a fault to be thrown on the next write operation for a specific GrainId.

methods.name: AddFaultOnClear
methods.description: Registers a fault to be thrown on the next clear operation for a specific GrainId.

methods.name: OnRead
methods.description: Triggers the stored exception for a read operation if registered, throwing it.

methods.name: OnWrite
methods.description: Triggers the stored exception for a write operation if registered, throwing it.

methods.name: OnClear
methods.description: Triggers the stored exception for a clear operation if registered, throwing it.
